title: Join us for the Knowledge Portal Webinar May 7th, 2026
bodyHtml:
? Sifting the Signal: Exploring and Prioritizing Genetic Variants with the Variant Sifter
? Thursday, May 7, 2026
⏰ 12:00–1:00 PM ET

In this webinar, you will learn:
How functional genomic data can be used to prioritize variants at a GWAS locus
How the Variant Sifter enables rapid, intuitive variant prioritization
How to engage with the tool and get your questions answered live


?️ Featured Speaker: Trang Nguyen, The Broad Institute

Whether you’re new to the Knowledge Portals or looking to deepen your analysis workflows, this session will provide practical insights and hands-on guidance.

? Register for the event: https://broadinstitute.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN__dgDoIUZSVyPwKvZ3Xx7mQ
summary: In this webinar, learn about how the Variant Sifter can help you explore and prioritize genetic variants.
